description:
AliExpress Scraper: Search Products, Prices & Orders

AliExpress search results without login or browser: product title, sale and original price, discount, orders sold, rating, image and item URL, with paging and sort by orders. $1.00 per 1,000 products.

Pricing (pay per event, billed to your Apify account): Product: $0.001.

Runs on Apify as subimpact/aliexpress-scraper.

_maxChargeUsd.description: Per-run spending cap in USD (default 0.5). Passed to Apify as the run option maxTotalChargeUsd, so the run stops when it reaches this charge.
_maxChargeUsd.title: Max charge (USD)

_maxItems.description: How many dataset items to return to the model (1-1000, default 50). Truncates the response only; it does not change what the Actor collects or charges for.
_maxItems.title: Max items returned

maxItems.description: Hard cap on how many product rows the whole run can deliver, across all keywords (1 to 10000). The run stops cleanly when it is reached. Only delivered products are charged.
maxItems.title: Max products per run

maxItemsPerSearch.description: How many products to collect for each keyword (1 to 600). AliExpress returns about 60 products per page, so 60 is one page and 120 is two pages. Paging stops early when AliExpress reports the last page or returns an empty page.
maxItemsPerSearch.title: Max products per keyword

proxyConfiguration.description: Apify datacenter proxy is the default and works for AliExpress search pages. Set useApifyProxy to false to go direct from the Apify platform. A proxy failure fails that request, it never silently falls back to a direct one.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

searchTerms.description: AliExpress search keywords, one per line, e.g. usb c cable or phone case. Each keyword is searched on its own and its results are paged. Links are not accepted: this actor reads search result pages, not product detail pages. Entries that cannot be read come back as free error rows. Leave empty to search for usb c cable.
searchTerms.title: Search keywords

sortBy.description: relevance keeps AliExpress's best-match order. orders sorts by how many units the listing sold, most first, which is the usual way to find proven products.
sortBy.title: Sort results by

name: aliexpress_products
